status: Implementation planning only. No additional record is certified reviewed, routed or complete by this preflight.

next_reusable_primitives.need: Configured attraction applied through swept player movement and projectile velocity for both teams; no firing. Broken Maw has a four-second active/inactive alternation and stronger attraction. Reuse physical statue body, plate shutdown and re-entry; source strength, attenuation and initial phase remain unknown.
next_reusable_primitives.tests: Moving/dodging/mouse player paths, projectile deflection in both factions, multiple attractors, no terrain tunneling, cycle boundaries and plate shutdown. Declare 3D vertical/force behavior as adaptations.

next_reusable_primitives.need: Anchored landing attack every three seconds with actual directional rock-wave propagation. Installed animations map left/up/right/down. Its attack must open supported secret/super-secret walls, with provenance separate from player-spent dynamite.
next_reusable_primitives.tests: All four axes, collision and destruction along the actual wave, pressure plates, persistence after combat, valid secret-wall access without incorrectly awarding enemy kills.

next_reusable_primitives.need: Bomb Grimace produces a real supplied Throwable Bomb. XML identifies it as type 4 / variant 13, outside the 653 enemy/boss rows. The current player dynamite deploy/throw path is not this interactive supply. Track the outstanding bomb and delay replenishment until taking it; exceptional destruction emits ten supplied bombs. Exact global-versus-per-supplier ownership and delay remain open.
next_reusable_primitives.tests: Taking, carrying/throwing, detonation, replacement, simultaneous suppliers, room changes and resource accounting; no decrement of ordinary inventory for supplied bombs. Required encounters must remain solvable.

dedicated_encounter_dependencies.name: Tuff Twins
needs: Two six-segment chains in a large arena; independent armor and segment HP.
15 armor and 35 segment HP in source units; non-explosive attacks do not damage armor. Explosive resistance persists after exposure; exact distance formula remains unknown.
At least two Bomb Grimaces and the real Throwable Bomb interaction.

Armored heads produce Ink (61.3.0), exposed heads Sucker (61.0.0). Shared room-count condition of four includes documented multi-spawn bursts; a hard global cap of four is not an established equivalent.
Exposed body shooting, speed change with armor loss, eligible split chains and correct group completion/rewards.
Named Terra/rock-wave/Plan C/Sulfuric Acid distinctions; exclude Repentance+ Hagalaz behavior.

dedicated_encounter_dependencies.name: The Shell
needs: Two five-segment chains in a large arena; diagonal flying/wall reflection and nearby head steering.
15 armor per segment, body-grounding on exposure and body-count-dependent slowdown. The head stays invulnerable until detached from all segments.
One or two Bomb Grimaces; exposed tail produces Fly Bomb (819.0.0), exposed middle emits three aimed shots.
Detached flesh groups pursue slowly; one isolated flesh body stays still and produces Fly Bombs.

Detailed split/new-head eligibility needs direct clarification: the pinned article describes a conditional three-segment branch despite also saying the boss cannot split into smaller copies. Preserve this ambiguity instead of applying the Tuff split rule.
Named armor exceptions and final cleanup; exclude Repentance+ Hagalaz behavior.

dedicated_encounter_dependencies.name: Mother's Shadow
needs: Dedicated Mines/Ashpit escape sub-area; it is not a kill-required combat enemy or ordinary final boss.
Installed XML specifies variant 0; the pinned wiki box says variant 1 and is currently joined by name. Resolve that source disagreement explicitly; do not invent a variant-1 runtime identity.
Invulnerable pursuit, stopping/charging, charge-only contact damage and cross-room continuity.
Temporary item/resource suppression and restoration with source exceptions, a return route populated with obstacles, supplied throwable bombs and one-way escape completion.

softlock_policy_to_resolve: The source documents possible Tuff Twins softlocks after destroying every supplier and wasting its bombs. The port goal requires completable encounters; any recovery supply or protected producer must be declared a DeathWard adaptation, not source parity.
